notes: Laminex Made to Measure laminate benchtops: the colour range page's decors, each at 33 mm; the National Availability Guide (October 2025) gives "ALL OPTIONS AVAILABLE ON PARTICLEBOARD MR IN 20, 25, 33 OR 38MM THICKNESS", and per colour the edges (self edged, 1 or 2 mm edging, rolled 3, 8 or 10 mm, half or full bullnose) and finishes: see the guide. Length: not stated; 3600 is our assumption. Kind laminate_top keeps them out of cabinet board pickers. No prices inferred.
